name: find_similar_molecules
description: Find similar chemical molecules based on a provided SMILES (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System) string. Use this tool when you want to identify compounds with similar structures or properties. Do NOT use this tool for non-chemical queries or to search for biological sequences; for those, consider using appropriate biological tools.

parameters.name: smiles
parameters.description: The SMILES representation of the molecule to find similarities for. Must be a valid SMILES string, which encodes the structure of the molecule. Length must be between 5 and 500 characters.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of similar molecules to return. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

parameters.name: similarity_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum similarity score (0.0 to 1.0) for returned molecules. Molecules with a similarity score below this threshold will be excluded. Defaults to 0.7 for moderate similarity.

similar_molecules.description: List of similar molecules, each represented by a structure containing: smiles (string), name (string), similarity_score (number).

smiles.description: SMILES representation of the similar molecule.

name.description: Common name or identifier of the similar molecule.

similarity_score.description: Similarity score between the input molecule and the similar molecule (0.0 to 1.0).

total_count.description: Total number of similar molecules found, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object containing a list of similar molecules and the total count of matches.
